_doc: FireRed/LeafGreen Viridian City has NO land encounters — this table is ours, the same calm-street life Pallet Town has, so the city is not dead between the buildings. Low levels and passive behaviour on purpose: these are the town's residents, not a route, and they sit at or below Route 1's own (Pidgey 2-5, Rattata 2-4). The grove and the pond-side park roll the bugs instead (data/encounters/viridian_grove.json); Viridian's real wild Pokémon are the water species at the pond (data/encounters/viridian_pond.json).
